items.label: 2 · Landmark
items.detail: The minimal diffusion barrier is one attenuated cell layer; in surface view the cells appear polygonal and their nuclei bulge slightly.
items.cue: Commit to: A single layer of flattened cells with flattened central nuclei.

items.label: 3 · Cells
items.detail: Mesothelial and endothelial cells are specialized simple squamous cells; type I pneumocytes also share this attenuated profile.
items.cue: Use nuclear shape, cytoplasm, matrix, and position together.

items.label: 4 · Separate
items.detail: Count layers before judging shape: simple squamous has one layer, whereas stratified squamous has many.
items.cue: State why the closest look-alike loses.
